The Naguri Furusato Festival will be held on Sunday, October 4, 2026 (Reiwa 8) from 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. at Nora Naguri (rain or shine for light rain).

The festival includes food and craft vendors (Otowa Ren-kai, Lakeside Terrace Naguri-ko, Sekine Meat Shop, Kominka Restaurant Pore Pore, PHASE5 J with Takashi, Nazar Kebab, Shanti, Naguri Genki Plaza, Taishokaku, Nijiro Pan Biyori, Nakayama Tea House, Asron Coffee Roastery, Comprehensive Care Center Taikouro, Workshop Yu, Naguri Beekeeping, Sawarabi-no-yu, Okumusashi Hanno Tourism Association, Ki-no-Eki Woodworking, Acupuncture/Moxibustion Slowly Mushi-do), stage performances (Naguri Elementary School Taiko Drum, Kids Dance, Daigoro Hara, Hanami Yosakai Dance, Yama × 2, Hula Naguri Lilia, Theater Lovers Japanese Dance, Four Piece Band), and working vehicle displays.

Please use public transportation (Kokusai Kogyo Bus: get off at "Nora Naguri / Sawarabi-no-yu" or "Kawamata (Naguri Lake entrance)").

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/shiminseikatsubu/gyoseicenterkanrika/nagurichikugyoseicenter_kominkan/10582.html
